scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ims/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w @ims/api" "npm run dev -w @ims/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ims/contracts && npm run build -w @ims/api && npm run build -w @ims/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ims/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
